title: Re-audit uses and transformations of the gastric NRRS study
plain_language_question: Which repair, biological adaptation, evidence extension, or structural reuse of the anchor can produce a beginner-executable manuscript?
biological_unit: Not applicable at the umbrella gate
decisive_evidence: A portfolio with explicit multi-axis change maps, independent assessments, and human-readable trade-offs
falsifier: Fewer than two scientifically coherent and feasible manuscript candidates survive the corrected G0 gates
learning_objective: Learn to distinguish correctness repair, scientific adaptation, evidence extension, and genuine redirection
target_contribution: A reviewed candidate portfolio rather than an automatically selected construct-audit paper
claim_ceiling: No manuscript claim is authorized by this umbrella direction

title: Neural, vascular, or stromal: construct validity and transportability of the published NRRS
plain_language_question: Does the published eight-gene NRRS contain neural information beyond stage, purity, and major tissue-composition programs, and does its relative prognostic association reproduce independently?
biological_unit: Patient within bulk cohort; patient or tissue section for cellular and spatial checks
decisive_evidence: Independent survival estimates plus prespecified decomposition against neural, endothelial, fibroblast, epithelial, purity, MSI, and stage controls
falsifier: The score cannot be reconstructed without outcome tuning or no independent data can distinguish neural signal from composition
learning_objective: Learn frozen-score reconstruction, cohort lineage, survival validation, confounding decomposition, and cellular localization
target_contribution: A construct and reproducibility audit of one published score
claim_ceiling: Associational construct validity and relative prognostic replication only; no causal neural or treatment-predictive claim

title: Patient-level neural-stromal niche states across gastric cancer progression
plain_language_question: Are reproducible neural or Schwann-associated tissue niches present across gastric cancer progression, and which stromal or immune states accompany them?
biological_unit: Patient or tissue section with identifiable neural or Schwann units
decisive_evidence: A patient-level state definition reproduced in two independent spatial or histologic resources
falsifier: Two independent resources do not capture credible neural or Schwann units or required patient metadata
learning_objective: Learn neural-cell annotation, replicate-aware testing, spatial neighborhoods, and cross-platform validation
target_contribution: A biologically focused cross-scale map of neural-stromal niches
claim_ceiling: Associational spatial ecology and prognosis linkage only; no denervation or neural-causality claim

title: Reproducible external benchmark of published gastric prognostic signatures
plain_language_question: Which fully specified gastric prognostic formulas can be reconstructed and add information beyond clinical stage in independent cohorts?
biological_unit: Patient within an independent survival cohort
decisive_evidence: A formula-completeness flowchart and prespecified external discrimination and incremental-value comparison
falsifier: Fewer than three formulas are complete or cohorts lack comparable endpoints and clinical baselines
learning_objective: Learn formula extraction, harmonization, discrimination, calibration limits, and fair benchmarking
target_contribution: A transparent reproducibility benchmark of published gastric prognostic formulas
claim_ceiling: Relative discrimination, reproducibility, and incremental association only; no deployment claim

title: Approximate reconstruction of public-data NRRS figures
plain_language_question: Which published NRRS figures can be independently reconstructed from public data, and which discrepancies are irreducible?
biological_unit: Patient or cell from the documented public cohorts
decisive_evidence: A figure-by-figure reconstruction and discrepancy ledger with frozen assumptions and tested adapters
falsifier: The score or principal public-data contrasts cannot be reconstructed under any defensible prespecified preprocessing
learning_objective: Learn GEO and TCGA preprocessing, survival analysis, single-cell annotation, provenance, and figure verification
target_contribution: A training reconstruction and reusable adapters, not a stand-alone manuscript
claim_ceiling: Descriptive similarity and discrepancy reporting only
